mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_system_config WHERE config_key=#{configKey} AND is_active=1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM t_system_config WHERE config_type='MASKING_RELEASE' AND config_version=#{version} AND record_status='DRAFT' AND is_active=0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM t_system_config WHERE config_type=#{configType} ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT FROM t_system_config WHERE config_type='MASKING_RELEASE' AND config_version=#{version} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM t_system_config WHERE config_type=#{configType} AND config_key=#{configKey} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_system_config WHERE config_type=#{configType}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_system_config SET lifecycle_status='PUBLISHED',record_status='PUBLISHED',effective_from=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), config_desc=#{reason},is_active=1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), config_value=JSON_SET(config_value,'$.publishedBy',#{actor},'$.publishedAt',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) WHERE id=#{id} AND config_type='MASKING_RELEASE'
